description: Na₃GaS₃ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are six inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four S atoms. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.74-3.05 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to five S atoms to form distorted NaS₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with five GaS₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent NaS₅ trigonal bipyramids, corners with two equivalent NaS₄ trigonal pyramids,  an edgeedge with one NaS₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one GaS₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaS₄ trigonal pyramid. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.77-3.12 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five S atoms. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.75-3.14 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to six S atoms. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.80-3.34 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded to six S atoms to form distorted NaS₆ octahedra that share corners with four GaS₄ tetrahedra, corners with three equivalent NaS₄ trigonal pyramids, edges with two equivalent NaS₆ octahedra, edges with two GaS₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaS₅ trigonal bipyramid. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.81-3.17 Å. In the sixth Na site, Na is bonded to four S atoms to form distorted NaS₄ trigonal pyramids that share corners with three equivalent NaS₆ octahedra, corners with three GaS₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent NaS₅ trigonal bipyramids,  an edgeedge with one GaS₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaS₅ trigonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 53-95°. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.80-2.85 Å. There are two inequivalent Ga sites. In the first Ga site, Ga is bonded to four S atoms to form GaS₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaS₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent NaS₅ trigonal bipyramids, corners with two equivalent NaS₄ trigonal pyramids,  an edgeedge with one NaS₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one GaS₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaS₅ trigonal bipyramid, and  an edgeedge with one NaS₄ trigonal pyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 2-50°. There are a spread of Ga-S bond distances ranging from 2.23-2.35 Å. In the second Ga site, Ga is bonded to four S atoms to form GaS₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaS₆ octahedra, corners with three equivalent NaS₅ trigonal bipyramids,  a cornercorner with one NaS₄ trigonal pyramid,  an edgeedge with one NaS₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one GaS₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 29-52°. There are a spread of Ga-S bond distances ranging from 2.22-2.35 Å. There are six inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to six Na and one Ga atom. In the second S site, S is bonded to six Na and one Ga atom to form distorted SNa₆Ga pentagonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent SNa₅Ga pentagonal pyramids, edges with two equivalent SNa₆Ga pentagonal bipyramids, and edges with two equivalent SNa₅Ga pentagonal pyramids. In the third S site, S is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na and two equivalent Ga atoms. In the fourth S site, S is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na and two equivalent Ga atoms. In the fifth S site, S is bonded to five Na and one Ga atom to form distorted SNa₅Ga pentagonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent SNa₆Ga pentagonal bipyramids, edges with two equivalent SNa₆Ga pentagonal bipyramids, and edges with two equivalent SNa₅Ga pentagonal pyramids. In the sixth S site, S is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to six Na and one Ga atom.
